calibration_method: Pre-2024: One point with 1413 μS/cm 2024 onwards: Two-point with either DI (0.1 μS/cm) and 147 μS/cmstandard or 147 μS/cm and 1413  μS/cm depending on site range.

calibration_method: One-point calibration using Zobell's ORP/Redox Calibration Solution (229 mV at 25 degrees C)
100 % saturation in-air calibration using wetted sponge
Notes: Stream morphology (ie. pool vs riffle) and shading patterns may affect readings

calibration_method: Two-point calibration using 10 NTU and 100 NTU standards
One-point calibration using solid state calibration block (8.25 RFU)
Yearly two-point calibration of sensor using DI (0 RFU) and rhodamine dye (500 μg/L, 2.9 RFU)
If AquaTROLL only, depth is calibrated using onboard barometric pressure sensor to in air conditions. If AquaTroll and Vulink are deployed together, VuLink Barometric Pressure compensation is applied
Notes: Sensor Housing shifts or bank changes are not accounted for in this dataset and depth is relative to current site conditions
